acceptanceCriteria: `corvint impact --capabilities` prints the listing outside any Git root, with a test.
The shifted GPK citation is re-anchored to the intended code.
body: PR #1313 GPK-V0-084..086: the impact root check in parse() runs before --capabilities, so the listing fails outside a Git checkout. Also re-anchor the GPK spec citation that was mechanically shifted to cmd/corvint/main.go:463 (`if err != nil {`), likely semantically stale.
title: `corvint impact --capabilities` requires a Git root although it reads no repository (V1-2047 residual)
